test_case.test_name: Parameterized iperf3 Ethernet multi-connection throughput validation
test_case.purpose: Measure Ethernet throughput on the bound NIC path using the approved parallel-connection, duration and interval profile and compare complete results with the applicable NIC specification.
required_package: SUT/peer roles, NIC BDF/interface/IP/VLAN/MTU/route/port and isolated physical path
Driver/firmware, link speed/FEC/autoneg and NUMA/CPU/power profile
Direction, number_of_connection, TEST_TIME, interval_time, window and server port
test_case.test_command: Capture both endpoint/NIC/path/counter baselines; verify the explicit SERVER_IP traverses the designated physical Ethernet link; install/use only approved iperf3; start the assigned server with recorded PID/readiness; from the distinct client run `iperf3 -c SERVER_IP -P number_of_connection -t TEST_TIME -i interval_time --logfile output.txt` with all values bound; preserve full client JSON/text and server output, counters and telemetry; stop only recorded processes and restore test settings.
test_case.expected_result: The exact approved multi-connection profile completes across the designated Ethernet path and meets every NIC throughput/stability threshold without unacceptable retransmits, errors or host/link regression.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires bound roles/path/profile, complete two-ended evidence and all approved thresholds. Guessed parameters, same-host loopback, tail-only output, missing threshold or health regression is BLOCKED/FAIL.
safety_gate: Confirm distinct endpoints and isolated physical Ethernet path.
Pin matching iperf3 artifacts; never assume a latest package.
Abort on production impact, path drift, link flap, error storm or CPU/thermal limit.
Track exact PIDs and restore only test-created state; no automatic rerun.
expected_evidence: iperf3 identities and fully bound command/profile
Complete server and client interval/final/retransmit output
Before/after NIC counters, CPU/thermal and system logs
Threshold matrix, cleanup and final health
test_case.recovery: On path/tool/link/host fault, stop exact test processes, preserve output and counters, restore test firewall/routing state and verify both endpoints; do not substitute another stream/time profile under this identity.
